title: Vascular Plants of Japan Database (VPJD): Reproducible Research Workflows
description: Reproducible R workflows supporting the Vascular Plants of Japan Database (VPJD), developed within the Oxford–Japan Plant Conservation Partnership (OJPCP). The repository contains version-controlled computational workflows for taxonomic reconciliation, data integration, geographic evidence processing, validation, and conservation analyses of the vascular flora of Japan. It accompanies the independently archived VPJD data releases and provides the computational framework supporting reproducibility, transparency, and reuse.
